mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5% signals a tightening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 5% and 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) above 800k signals strong demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST > 800k and 5-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% MoM signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO MoM < -2% and 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 8% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) decreases by more than 100k, it signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE > 8% and PAYEMS MoM < -100k, and 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 50 basis points signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS increases > 50bps and 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real final sales (RSAFS) above $400 billion signals strong consumer demand, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS > $400 billion and 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 1% YoY signals a contraction in economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 YoY < -1% and 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.
